baseline: pnl_net_open (honest grade, 18:00-open fill, own-pair resolution, base costs); hicost = pnl_net_open_hicost

spec.S1: geometry re-call only: H2 target cap 1.0 x med20 + H3 (no CONTINUATION|wide; MEAN REVERSION|wide needs ratio >= 0.80)
spec.S2: the four-rule spec of the first draft (S1 + free vetoes H5 and H9); SUPERSEDED: H2 is dead under LAB_DESIGN 2.6 (placebo) and H3 is discovery-only under 12.3; kept for attribution
spec.S3: redundancy check: S2 + D1 Detector B veto (MR with pB_dir >= 0.70 -> NO EDGE; CONT with pB_dir <= 0.10 -> NO EDGE); identical to S2 on NQ
spec.S4: free vetoes plus D1 on the baseline call (H5 + H9 + D1), no geometry change
spec.S5: H3 alone (H2 cap not applied) + H5 + H9 + D1
spec.S6: GRADE A PRIME = the paper-trading spec: honest baseline + the two free vetoes H5 (|post_ret| > 0.3% or megacap print) and H9 (pre_holiday); no geometry change, no D1
spec.S7: SHADOW spec: H3 (no CONTINUATION|wide; MEAN REVERSION|wide needs ratio >= 0.80) + H5 + H9; no H2, no D1; logged nightly, not paper-traded

parameters.H3_floor_convention: raw ratio win_rate_on_resolution (not the rounded confidence); see h_geometry_results.json H3_floor_convention
parameters.H9_flag: pre_holiday == 1 only (calendar_features: the next CALENDAR day is a US holiday; a Friday before a Monday holiday is not flagged); holiday_tomorrow is NOT part of the scored rule (the vetoes group's H9_proxy union is reported, not scored here)

usd_note: per-rule and per-spec USD figures are each measured against the honest baseline alone and are NOT additive across rules; the joint effect of a spec is its own paired figure

attribution_pairs.desc: free vetoes H5 + H9 over the honest baseline (= GRADE A PRIME minus baseline)
shadow spec (H3 + H5 + H9) over the honest baseline
H3's increment inside the shadow spec, over the free vetoes
the superseded four-rule spec over the honest baseline
geometry layer (H2 + H3) increment over the free vetoes
H2's increment inside the superseded spec (S2 minus the H3-only shadow)
H2's increment with D1 in both legs (S2 minus S5; S5 = S7 on NQ)

trial_ledger.note: lower bound on trials: the seven honest-baseline ladder steps, the placebo re-draws (300 per placebo, which are nulls, not candidate rules) and the forensic looks that sized the backlog are not counted
